inputs.name: listLoopTemplates.root
inputs.description: Repository directory used to find project template JSON files in `specification/loop-templates`. A missing template directory contributes no project templates.

inputs.name: resolveLoopTemplate.root
inputs.description: Repository directory used to find project template JSON files in `specification/loop-templates`. A missing template directory contributes no project templates.

inputs.name: resolveLoopTemplate.id
inputs.description: Identifier validated and selected from the available built-in and project loop templates. The identifier must match a template; missing templates and inheritance cycles fail.

outputs.name: listLoopTemplates
outputs.description: Built-in templates followed by project templates read from `<root>/specification/loop-templates`, with project files processed in filename order. Project entries are normalized and their source is set to `project`; a missing directory adds no project entries.

outputs.name: resolveLoopTemplate
outputs.description: The selected template with its inheritance lineage, merged steps, and merged evaluators. Child entries replace parent entries with matching ids, while new child ids are appended; missing ids and inheritance cycles fail.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Validation rejects invalid loop ids or required text, and resolution rejects a missing template or an inheritance cycle.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Invalid JSON in a project template file rejects while the file is parsed.

errors.name: Loop template directory or file read failure
errors.description: File-system errors from listing the project template directory or reading a template file propagate, except a missing directory is treated as empty.
